title: Armstrong's trumpet section and Mosley's time in the band
summary: Gus Aiken, Ham Davis, Louis Bacon and later Red Allen; he was in the band over a year.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: They had a worse click in Louie's band than they had in Claude's.
Yeah, I would guess so.
Those New Orleans guys
Was Red in the band with you?
Oh yeah.
I didn't think he was with you. I thought the guys in the band with you were Gus Aiken and Ham--Ham Davis.
Ham Davis was in the band.
Wasn't Louie Bacon in the band with you?
Louis Bacon was in the band.
Those were the three trumpets.
No, Red Allen too.
Red Allen came in during the time that you were in the band?
Oh yeah, long time.
You were still in the band?
Long time.
Then you were in the band well over a year then?
Well over a year.
It must have been a year and a half.
Yeah.
That's it; if you were in the band with Red Allen, that meant you had to be in the band from all of '36 and part of '37.
